name: Hellish Blizzard

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 800% ATK DMG to all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies for 2 rounds. [Lock]: Prevents the affected unit from triggering [Follow-Up], [Continuous Follow-Up], and [Combo Follow-Up]. Before any character acts, deals 100% ATK [Lock] DoT to the affected unit. This DMG can CRIT and cannot be [Evaded].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1000% ATK DMG to all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies for 2 rounds. [Lock]: Prevents the affected unit from triggering [Follow-Up], [Continuous Follow-Up], and [Combo Follow-Up]. Before any character acts, deals 130% ATK [Lock] DoT to the affected unit. This DMG can CRIT and cannot be [Evaded].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently increases own Continuous DMG by 60%. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently increases own Continuous DMG by 80%. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently increases own Continuous DMG by 100%. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After any enemy triggers [Lock], immediately triggers [Continuous Explosion]. [Continuous Explosion]: Immediately splashes to surrounding targets, dealing 80% of the [Lock] DMG and DoT DMG. This DMG can CRIT and cannot be dodged.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: After any enemy triggers [Lock], immediately triggers [Continuous Explosion]. When battle begins, has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies with 50% ATK DMG for 1 round. [Continuous Explosion]: Immediately splashes to all enemies, dealing 90% of the [Lock] DMG and DoT DMG. This DMG can CRIT and cannot be dodged.

effects.desc: A general positive enhancing effect applies to the character, raising stats or granting benefits (e.g. increasing Hit Rate or damage dealt).
The control state prevents the target from activating Charge, Continuous Charge, Link, and Special attacks.
The effect immediately spreads to surrounding targets, dealing 80% ST over Locked's duration.
Additional damage dealt by critical hits; is often adjusted via [Crit DMG Reduction] to cut down on this addition.
Ice damage effects are added to attacks, dealing them to enemies along with the main attack.
